convention: At one common positive angular frequency, use exp(-i*omega*t). The supplied tensors are the real symmetric imaginary parts of reciprocal relative dielectric tensors in one common orthonormal2Dframe. Average dissipated power is(omega*epsilon0/2)*E^T*loss_tensor*E for a real field amplitude E. The common positive prefactor need not be evaluated.
eligibility: A candidate satisfies the declared single-frequency passivity criterion exactly when its quadratic loss is nonnegative for EVERY real E. Eigenvalues of magnitude<=1e-10count as zero. A lossless direction is allowed. Positive tensor trace or positive diagonal entries alone are insufficient. This criterion at one frequency is not a proof of full-frequency causality or material stability.
selection: Among eligible candidates choose the largest maximum dissipated-power factor at||E||2=1. Equal factors within1e-10tie; choose lexical candidate ID. Report the factor and E2/E1for its maximizing direction in ORIGINAL coordinates; simultaneous field sign reversal has no effect.

provenance.data_origin: Explicit benchmark-constructed model data. Energies and response tensors are conditional illustrative inputs, not claimed first-principles calculations or experimental properties of a named material.
